title: Islands of Light / Unbound
description: Complete your alliance’s final operation against the distributed fallback system.
objective: Evacuate protected identities at Authoritative record / Capture controller at Response controller
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: Independent districts keep their own power and identity ledgers. The Directorate loses its monopoly on continuity. The release reaches every district at once. It breaks the old consensus and leaves difficult repairs for the survivors.

lore.title: Islands of Light / Unbound / Unsent message
lore.text: SABLE / community grid engineer: Complete your alliance’s final operation against the distributed fallback system. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.
